The only way to make this happen is if you truly love your craft and are deeply committed to growth. About The Role HackerRank’s coding challenge library is the foundation of how companies identify top technical talent. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll drive the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of products that expand our skills coverage, raise content quality, and increase adoption among customers. This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, design, and content. You’ll define product requirements, translate complex business and customer needs into scalable solutions, and partner with a global network of subject matter experts. You’ll also work closely with customers to shape workflows and ensure our assessments remain relevant, fair, and impactful for developers and hiring teams worldwide. Partner with customers to deeply understand their workflows and deliver tailored solutions that drive adoption and impact. Use data, automation, and AI to streamline content creation and review processes. Ensure every product and feature shipped upholds high standards of fairness, validity, and developer experience. Bring 5+ years of product or technical program experience in fast-paced environments, with at least 2 years in a customer-facing capacity.
